description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LDAPUser class within the LDAP DTO package of OrangeHRM. It tests setting properties on LDAPUser instances and verifies serialization outputs, including setting lookup settings and employee mappings.

classes.name: LDAPUserTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for LDAPUser, verifying property setters, serialization, and nested lookup settings with employee mappings.

methods.name: testLDAPUser
methods.description: Tests creating an LDAPUser object, setting basic properties, and verifying the serialized output matches expected hex-encoded string.

methods.name: testLDAPUserWithLookupSetting
methods.description: Tests creating an LDAPUser with a lookup setting and employee selector mapping, ensuring that serialization output matches the expected hex-encoded string for complex object setup.
